p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything at seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: Seller delivers goods to buyer's shipment.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller places the cargo on the ship; then the risk and expenses are on the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: The buyer pays the freight and insurance to the carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: The seller delivers to a specified destination, the buyer pays the import charges.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: Seller pays everything, including import contract.
